name: Fiona Apple
who_line: She told a room full of video outfits not to copy the outfits.
who: Fiona Apple arrived as a teenager with Tidal (1996) and a voice that did not ask permission. The 1997 MTV Video Music Awards speech is the clothes quote: she told everybody watching not to model a life on what the industry thought was cool.

Texture over logo: filet crochet, silk, cotton jersey, a waist chain. Nineties undone — messy hair, smudged eye, no house. The crochet dress is not a designer moment. It is what a 19-year-old wore to say the world is bullshit.
work: Sleep to Dream won Best New Artist in a Video. Press at the time called the speech ungrateful. The speech is on video, on MTV’s own channel. She cited Maya Angelou: we as human beings at our best can only create opportunities.

Later records (When the Pawn…, Extraordinary Machine, The Idler Wheel…, Fetch the Bolt Cutters) kept the same refusal to be a waif in a lily field. Photographer Joe McNally remembered her asking to chuck that scene and be a warrior woman in a suit of armour — his recollection, not her byline.

quotes.text: So what I want to say is everybody out there that’s watching, everybody that’s watching this world. This world is bullshit! And you shouldn’t model your life—wait a second—you shouldn’t model your life about what you think that we think is cool, and what we’re wearing and what we’re saying and everything. Go with yourself. Go with yourself.
quotes.said_to: MTV Video Music Awards, Best New Artist in a Video, Radio City Music Hall. Presented by Elton John. Unscripted.

quotes.text: Fiona had always been shot as a waif — tendrils of hair blowing, dressed in lingerie, out in some sort of lily field. She told me she wanted to chuck that scene and be a warrior woman in a suit of armour.
quotes.said_to: Joe McNally quoting her, The Moment It Clicks; circulated by i-D. Not her byline.

why_the_look: She would not model a life on what the industry thought was cool. The crochet dress is not a designer moment. It is what a 19-year-old wore to say the world is bullshit.
beliefs: The VMA speech cites Maya Angelou. PETA work in the late 90s is photographed; do not inflate it into a politics section.

moments.title: MTV VMAs — filet crochet
moments.garments: White filet crochet dress, floral motif, scalloped uneven hem, over what reads as a white bra + slip skirt (Roe Magazine).
moments.designer_season: none / unsourced. Not Prada. Do not say Prada.
moments.where_it_lives: Broadcast tape. Official MTV YouTube upload of the speech.
moments.why_iconic: The speech is the clothes quote. She told a room full of video outfits not to copy the outfits.
